sanskrit: ādityānām avasā nūtanena sakṣīmahi śarmaṇā śaṁtamena | anāgāstve adititve turāsa imaṁ yajñaṁ dadhatu śroṣamāṇāḥ ||
english: With the fresh aid of the Ādityas may we obtain the most blissful shelter. In a state of sinlessness, in a state of Aditi's grace, may the swift ones — listening — establish this sacrifice.

sanskrit: ādityāso aditir mādayantām mitro aryamā varuṇo rajiṣṭhāḥ | asmākaṁ santu bhuvanasya gopāḥ pibantu somam avase no adya ||
english: Let the Ādityas and Aditi rejoice — Mitra, Aryaman, Varuṇa the most righteous. May they be guardians of our world; let them drink the Soma today for our protection.

sanskrit: ādityā viśve marutaś ca viśve devāś ca viśva ṛbhavaś ca viśve | indro agnir aśvinā tuṣṭuvānā yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: All the Ādityas, all the Maruts, all the gods, and all the Ṛbhus — Indra, Agni, and the Aśvins being praised — do ye all protect us always with blessings.

sanskrit: ādityāso aditayaḥ syāma pūr devatrā vasavo martyatrā | sanema mitrāvaruṇā sananto bhavema dyāvāpṛthivī bhavantaḥ ||
english: May we be Ādityas, may we be Aditis — foremost among gods, Vasus among mortals. Winning through Mitra-Varuṇa as we win, may we become as Heaven and Earth endure.

sanskrit: mitras tan no varuṇo māmahanta śarma tokāya tanayāya gopāḥ | mā vo bhujemānyajātam eno mā tat karma vasavo yac cayadhve ||
english: May Mitra and Varuṇa, as guardians, grant us shelter for our offspring and progeny. May we not enjoy what sin belongs to others; O Vasus, may we not commit that deed you would requite.

sanskrit: turaṇyavo 'ṅgiraso nakṣanta ratnaṁ devasya savitur iyānāḥ | pitā ca tan no mahān yajatro viśve devāḥ samanaso juṣanta ||
english: The swift Aṅgirasas, going toward the treasure of divine Savitṛ, approach it swiftly. That great adorable Father — may all the gods with one mind accept it for us.

sanskrit: pra dyāvā yajñaiḥ pṛthivī namobhiḥ sabādha īḻe bṛhatī yajatre | te cid dhi pūrve kavayo gṛṇantaḥ puro mahī dadhire devaputre ||
english: With sacrifices I earnestly laud Heaven, and Earth with reverences — the two vast, adorable ones. For even the ancient seers, while singing praise, set these two great, divine-born ones in the forefront.

sanskrit: pra pūrvaje pitarā navyasībhir gīrbhiḥ kṛṇudhvaṁ sadane ṛtasya | ā no dyāvāpṛthivī daivyena janena yātam mahi vāṁ varūtham ||
english: Honor these two primeval Parents with ever-fresh hymns in the seat of Ṛta. O Heaven and Earth, come to us with your divine host; great is your protection.

sanskrit: uto hi vāṁ ratnadheyāni santi purūṇi dyāvāpṛthivī sudāse | asme dhattaṁ yad asad askṛdhoyu yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: For yours are the many treasure-gifts, O Heaven and Earth, for the liberal sacrificer. Bestow upon us what shall be inexhaustible; do ye protect us always with blessings.

sanskrit: vāstoṣ pate prati jānīhy asmān svāveśo anamīvo bhavā naḥ | yat tvemahe prati tan no juṣasva śaṁ no bhava dvipade śaṁ catuṣpade ||
english: O Lord of the homestead, recognize us; enter graciously and be free of disease for us. Whatever we think of you, accept that; be auspicious to us for our bipeds and our quadrupeds.

sanskrit: vāstoṣ pate prataraṇo na edhi gayasphāno gobhir aśvebhir indo | ajarāsas te sakhye syāma piteva putrān prati no juṣasva ||
english: O Lord of the homestead, be for us a furtherer — prospering with cattle and horses our home, O drop of Soma. May we be ageless in your friendship; as a father to his sons, accept us graciously.

sanskrit: vāstoṣ pate śagmayā saṁsadā te sakṣīmahi raṇvayā gātumatyā | pāhi kṣema uta yoge varaṁ no yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: O Lord of the homestead, may we join your gracious and joyful assembly that opens a path. Protect our rest and our labor; give us the best. Do ye protect us always with blessings.

sanskrit: amīvahā vāstoṣ pate viśvā rūpāṇy āviśan | sakhā suśeva edhi naḥ ||
english: O Lord of the homestead, dispeller of disease, entering all forms, be a gentle and kindly friend to us.

sanskrit: yad arjuna sārameya dataḥ piśaṅga yacchase | vīva bhrājanta ṛṣṭaya upa srakveṣu bapsato ni ṣu svapa ||
english: O white-toothed son of Saramā, tawny one, when you snarl — your fangs glitter as spear-points at your jaws while you gnaw; do sleep now.

sanskrit: stenaṁ rāya sārameya taskaraṁ vā punaḥsara | stotṝn indrasya rāyasi kim asmān ducchunāyase ni ṣu svapa ||
english: Son of Saramā, go back again after the thief or the robber. Why do you bark at Indra's praisers and trouble us? Do sleep now.

sanskrit: tvaṁ sūkarasya dardṛhi tava dardartu sūkaraḥ | stotṝn indrasya rāyasi kim asmān ducchunāyase ni ṣu svapa ||
english: You tear the boar apart; let the boar tear you. You bark at Indra's praisers — why do you trouble us? Do sleep now.

sanskrit: sastu mātā sastu pitā sastu śvā sastu viśpatiḥ | sasantu sarve jñātayaḥ sastv ayam abhito janaḥ ||
english: Let the mother sleep, let the father sleep, let the dog sleep, let the lord of the clan sleep. Let all the kinsmen sleep; let all the people round about sleep.

sanskrit: ya āste yaś ca carati yaś ca paśyati no janaḥ | teṣāṁ saṁ hanmo akṣāṇi yathedaṁ harmyaṁ tathā ||
english: Those who sit, those who move about, those who look upon us — their eyes we close together, just as this mansion is shut up.

sanskrit: sahasraśṛṅgo vṛṣabho yaḥ samudrād udācarat | tenā sahasyenā vayaṁ ni janān svāpayāmasi ||
english: The thousand-horned bull who has risen up from the ocean — with him, the mighty one, we lull the people to sleep.

sanskrit: proṣṭheśayā vahyeśayā nārīr yās talpaśīvarīḥ | striyo yāḥ puṇyagandhās tāḥ sarvāḥ svāpayāmasi ||
english: Women who lie on cushions, women who lie in carriages, women who lie on couches — all the fragrant women, all of them we lull to sleep.

sanskrit: ka īṁ vyaktā naraḥ sanīḻā rudrasya maryā adha svaśvāḥ ||
english: Who, sharing the same nest, has clearly made them known — Rudra's young men, well-horsed indeed?

sanskrit: nakir hy eṣāṁ janūṁṣi veda te aṅga vidre mitho janitram ||
english: For no one truly knows their births; they themselves know each other's origin.

sanskrit: abhi svapūbhir mitho vapanta vātasvanasaḥ śyenā aspṛdhran ||
english: Roaring like the wind, like eagles they strove with one another, sprinkling with their own purifying streams.

sanskrit: etāni dhīro niṇyā ciketa pṛśnir yad ūdho mahī jabhāra ||
english: These secret things the wise man has discerned — what great udder the dappled cow, Pṛśni, bore.

sanskrit: sā viṭ suvīrā marudbhir astu sanāt sahantī puṣyantī nṛmṇam ||
english: May that tribe be rich in heroes with the Maruts, ever victorious, ever flourishing in manly might.

sanskrit: yāmaṁ yeṣṭhāḥ śubhā śobhiṣṭhāḥ śriyā sammiślā ojobhir ugrāḥ ||
english: Most swift in their course, most lovely, most lustrous, mixed with splendor, mighty with their strength.

sanskrit: ugraṁ va ojaḥ sthirā śavāṁsy adhā marudbhir gaṇas tuviṣmān ||
english: Fierce is your might, firm are your powers; verily the troop with the Maruts is strong indeed.

sanskrit: śubhro vaḥ śuṣmaḥ krudhmī manāṁsi dhunir munir iva śardhasya dhṛṣṇoḥ ||
english: Bright is your breath, it shakes the mind to anger, like a sage of the bold host who trembles with power.

sanskrit: sanemy asmad yuyota didyum mā vo durmatir iha praṇaṅ naḥ ||
english: Turn away the lightning-bolt from us; let not your ill-will come upon us here.

sanskrit: priyā vo nāma huve turāṇām ā yat tṛpan maruto vāvaśānāḥ ||
english: I invoke your dear names, O swift ones, when the Maruts, eager, have drunk their fill.

sanskrit: svāyudhāsa iṣmiṇaḥ suniṣkā uta svayaṁ tanvaḥ śumbhamānāḥ ||
english: Well-armed, impetuous, adorned with fine necklaces, they themselves adorn their own bodies.

sanskrit: śucī vo havyā marutaḥ śucīnāṁ śuciṁ hinomy adhvaraṁ śucibhyaḥ | ṛtena satyam ṛtasāpa āyañ chucijanmānaḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāḥ ||
english: Pure are your oblations, O Maruts, pure ones; I send forth the pure sacrifice to the pure. By Ṛta the guardians of Ṛta came to truth — pure-born, pure, and purifying.

sanskrit: aṁseṣv ā marutaḥ khādayo vo vakṣaḥsu rukmā upaśiśriyāṇāḥ | vi vidyuto na vṛṣṭibhī rucānā anu svadhām āyudhair yacchamānāḥ ||
english: On your shoulders, O Maruts, are bracelets; on your chests, gold ornaments are pressed. Flashing like lightning with the rains, guiding your weapons according to your own nature.

sanskrit: pra budhnyā va īrate mahāṁsi pra nāmāni prayajyavas tiradhvam | sahasriyaṁ damyam bhāgam etaṁ gṛhamedhīyam maruto juṣadhvam ||
english: Forth proceed your deepest greatnesses; spread forth your names, O you most worthy of worship. Enjoy this share worthy of a thousand, fit for the household, the home-sacrificer's portion, O Maruts.

sanskrit: yadi stutasya maruto adhīthetthā viprasya vājino havīman | makṣū rāyaḥ suvīryasya dāta nū cid yam anya ādabhad arāvā ||
english: If, O Maruts, you attend to the praise of the inspired poet rich in offerings, swiftly bestow the wealth of heroic strength — even that which some niggardly stranger has held back.

sanskrit: atyāso na ye marutaḥ svañco yakṣadṛśo na śubhayanta maryāḥ | te harmyeṣṭhāḥ śiśavo na śubhrā vatsāso na prakrīḻinaḥ payodhāḥ ||
english: Like swift coursers striding forward, like young men of fair appearance bright as divine visions, dwelling in stately homes, bright as calves that gambol and are full of milk.

sanskrit: daśasyanto no maruto mṛḻantu varivasyanto rodasī sumeke | āre gohā nṛhā vadho vo astu sumnebhir asme vasavo namadhvam ||
english: Honoring us, may the Maruts grant us bliss; favoring us, O well-formed Heaven and Earth. May your destructive weapon be far from our cattle and our men; O Vasus, bow to us with grace.

sanskrit: ā vo hotā johavīti sattaḥ satrācīṁ rātim maruto gṛṇānaḥ | ya īvato vṛṣaṇo asti gopāḥ so advayāvī havate va ukthaiḥ ||
english: Your Hotā, seated and singing praises, constantly calls you and calls the Maruts for a joint gift. He who is guardian of those who travel — that guileless one invokes you with lauds.

sanskrit: ime turam maruto rāmayantīme sahaḥ sahasa ā namanti | ime śaṁsaṁ vanuṣyato ni pānti guru dveṣo araruṣe dadhanti ||
english: These Maruts grant swift delight; these bow their force before force. These protect the praise of him who would win, and they lay heavy enmity on the malevolent.

sanskrit: ime radhraṁ cin maruto junanti bhṛmiṁ cid yathā vasavo juṣanta | apa bādhadhvaṁ vṛṣaṇas tamāṁsi dhatta viśvaṁ tanayaṁ tokam asme ||
english: These Maruts impel even the feeble; even the violent they welcome as Vasus. Drive away the darknesses, O bulls; bestow on us all offspring and progeny.

sanskrit: mā vo dātrān maruto nir arāma mā paścād daghma rathyo vibhāge | ā naḥ spārhe bhajatanā vasavye yad īṁ sujātaṁ vṛṣaṇo vo asti ||
english: Let us not fall away from your gifts, O Maruts, nor be left behind in the distribution of wealth. Grant us a share in the desirable Vasu-treasure — whatever is well-born among you, O bulls.

sanskrit: saṁ yad dhananta manyubhir janāsaḥ śūrā yahvīṣv oṣadhīṣu vikṣu | adha smā no maruto rudriyāsas trātāro bhūta pṛtanāsv aryaḥ ||
english: When people clash in fury, heroes among the young herbs in the settlements — then, O Maruts, sons of Rudra, be our protectors and noble defenders in the battles.

sanskrit: bhūri cakra marutaḥ pitryāṇy ukthāni yā vaḥ śasyante purā cit | marudbhir ugraḥ pṛtanāsu sāḻhā marudbhir it sanitā vājam arvā ||
english: Many are the ancestral hymns fashioned for you, O Maruts, that were recited in the past. Mighty with the Maruts is one vanquished in battle; only with the Maruts does the horse win strength.

sanskrit: asme vīro marutaḥ śuṣmy astu janānāṁ yo asuro vidhartā | apo yena sukṣitaye taremādha svam oko abhi vaḥ syāma ||
english: May there be a vigorous hero among us, O Maruts — one who is asura among men, the upholder. With him may we cross the waters to a good dwelling; then may we be at home in your presence.

sanskrit: tan na indro varuṇo mitro agnir āpa oṣadhīr vanino juṣanta | śarman syāma marutām upasthe yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: May Indra, Varuṇa, Mitra, Agni, the Waters, the plants, and the forests accept that for us. May we be in the shelter of the Maruts' lap; do ye protect us always with blessings.

sanskrit: madhvo vo nāma mārutaṁ yajatrāḥ pra yajñeṣu śavasā madanti | ye rejayanti rodasī cid urvī pinvanty utsaṁ yad ayāsur ugrāḥ ||
english: Sweet is your name, O adorable Maruts; with power they exult in the sacrifices — they who make even the wide Heaven and Earth tremble and fill the fountain when they have gone forth in their might.

sanskrit: nicetāro hi maruto gṛṇantam praṇetāro yajamānasya manma | asmākam adya vidatheṣu barhir ā vītaye sadata pipriyāṇāḥ ||
english: For the Maruts are discerners of the singer, guides of the worshipper's thought. Today, well pleased, sit on our sacred grass in the assemblies for your refreshment.

sanskrit: naitāvad anye maruto yatheme bhrājante rukmair āyudhais tanūbhiḥ | ā rodasī viśvapiśaḥ piśānāḥ sa mānam añjy añjate śubhe kam ||
english: No others shine as these Maruts do, glittering with their golden ornaments, their weapons, their bodies. Adorning Heaven and Earth with all-manner shapes, they smear the same ointment for their own beauty.

sanskrit: ṛdhak sā vo maruto didyud astu yad va āgaḥ puruṣatā karāma | mā vas tasyām api bhūmā yajatrā asme vo astu sumatiś caniṣṭhā ||
english: Aside from us let that lightning of yours be, O Maruts, whatever offense we mortals may commit. May we not come under its stroke, O adorable ones; let your most kindly grace be ours.

sanskrit: kṛte cid atra maruto raṇantānavadyāsaḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāḥ | pra ṇo 'vata sumatibhir yajatrāḥ pra vājebhis tirata puṣyase naḥ ||
english: Even in the fray delight us here, O Maruts, blameless, pure, and purifying. O adorable ones, protect us with your graces; send us forward with prizes for our flourishing.

sanskrit: uta stutāso maruto vyantu viśvebhir nāmabhir naro havīṁṣi | dadāta no amṛtasya prajāyai jigṛta rāyaḥ sūnṛtā maghāni ||
english: Let the praised Maruts, heroes, come with all their names to our oblations. Grant us offspring of immortal kind; seize riches, cheerful bounties.

sanskrit: ā stutāso maruto viśva ūtī acchā sūrīn sarvatātā jigāta | ye nas tmanā śatino vardhayanti yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: Come, O praised Maruts, with all your aids to the lords of Soma for complete protection. They who by themselves increase our hundredfold strength — do ye protect us always with blessings.

sanskrit: pra sākamukṣe arcatā gaṇāya yo daivyasya dhāmnas tuviṣmān | uta kṣodanti rodasī mahitvā nakṣante nākaṁ nirṛter avaṁśāt ||
english: Sing praise to the troop that exults together, mighty in the dwelling of the divine. By their greatness they make Heaven and Earth tremble and reach the vault of heaven, away from Nirṛti's domain.

sanskrit: janūś cid vo marutas tveṣyeṇa bhīmāsas tuvimanyavo 'yāsaḥ ||pra ye mahobhir ojasota santi viśvo vo yāman bhayate svardṛk ||
english: Even your birth, O Maruts, is fearsome with its violence — dreadful, fiercely wrathful, tireless ones. They who surpass all with their greatness and strength — all that has sight of the sky fears at your passage.

sanskrit: bṛhad vayo maghavadbhyo dadhāta jujoṣann in marutaḥ suṣṭutiṁ naḥ | gato nādhvā vi tirāti jantum pra ṇaḥ spārhābhir ūtibhis tireta ||
english: Grant great vigor to the bountiful ones; the Maruts have indeed enjoyed our good praise. A pathless road does not foil the creature; lead us forward with your desirable aids.

sanskrit: yuṣmoto vipro marutaḥ śatasvī yuṣmoto arvā sahuriḥ sahasrī | yuṣmotaḥ samrāḻ uta hanti vṛtram pra tad vo astu dhūtayo deṣṇam ||
english: From you, O Maruts, the inspired poet gains a hundredfold; from you the horse becomes enduring and thousandfold. From you the sovereign ruler slays Vṛtra; let that gift of yours be proclaimed, O shakers.

sanskrit: tām ā rudrasya mīḻhuṣo vivāse kuvin naṁsante marutaḥ punar naḥ | yat sasvartā jihīḻire yad āvir ava tad ena īmahe turāṇām ||
english: I seek that company of the bountiful Rudra; will the Maruts return to us again? Whatever offense was turned away, whatever was brought to light — we seek forgiveness of that from the swift ones.

sanskrit: pra sā vāci suṣṭutir maghonām idaṁ sūktam maruto juṣanta | ārāc cid dveṣo vṛṣaṇo yuyota yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: In speech this goodly praise of bountiful ones goes forth; let the Maruts enjoy this hymn. Turn hatred far away from us, O bulls; do ye protect us always with blessings.

sanskrit: yaṁ trāyadhva idam-idaṁ devāso yaṁ ca nayatha | tasmā agne varuṇa mitrāryaman marutaḥ śarma yacchata ||
english: Him whom you protect here and there, O gods, and him whom you guide — to him, O Agni, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, and Maruts, grant shelter.

sanskrit: yuṣmākaṁ devā avasāhani priya ījānas tarati dviṣaḥ | pra sa kṣayaṁ tirate vi mahīr iṣo yo vo varāya dāśati ||
english: Under your protection daily, O gods, he who sacrifices with devotion passes beyond his foes. He who offers to you for his choosing passes beyond his home and wins great refreshments.

sanskrit: nahi vaś caramaṁ cana vasiṣṭhaḥ parimaṁsate | asmākam adya marutaḥ sute sacā viśve pibata kāminaḥ ||
english: Not even the last of you does Vasiṣṭha despise. Today, O Maruts, all of you, willingly, drink together at our Soma pressing.

sanskrit: nahi va ūtiḥ pṛtanāsu mardhati yasmā arādhvaṁ naraḥ | abhi va āvart sumatir navīyasī tūyaṁ yāta pipīṣavaḥ ||
english: Your aid fails not in battles for him to whom you, O heroes, grant it. May your ever-fresher grace turn toward us; come swiftly, you who are eager to drink.

sanskrit: o ṣu ghṛṣvirādhaso yātanāndhāṁsi pītaye | imā vo havyā maruto rare hi kam mo ṣv anyatra gantana ||
english: O Maruts of impetuous bounty, do come and bring the food-draughts for drinking. These oblations are offered to you; I give them with goodwill — do not go elsewhere.

sanskrit: ā ca no barhiḥ sadatāvitā ca naḥ spārhāṇi dātave vasu | asredhanto marutaḥ somye madhau svāheha mādayādhvai ||
english: Come and sit on our sacred grass, and as helpers give us the desirable wealth. Unerring Maruts, in the sweet Soma draught, be gladdened here with Svāhā.

sanskrit: sasvaś cid dhi tanvaḥ śumbhamānā ā haṁsāso nīlapṛṣṭhā apaptan | viśvaṁ śardho abhito mā ni ṣeda naro na raṇvāḥ savane madantaḥ ||
english: Adorning their own bodies, like blue-backed swans they flew here. The whole troop settled around me — heroes joyful and exulting at the Soma-pressing.

sanskrit: yo no maruto abhi durhṛṇāyus tiraś cittāni vasavo jighāṁsati | druhaḥ pāśān prati sa mucīṣṭa tapiṣṭhena hanmanā hantanā tam ||
english: He who, O Maruts, maliciously plans against us, who wishes to slay us across our thoughts, O Vasus — may he loose himself into the noose of deceit; smite him with the most burning stroke.

sanskrit: sāṁtapanā idaṁ havir marutas taj jujuṣṭana | yuṣmākotī riśādasaḥ ||
english: O Sāntapana Maruts, enjoy this oblation; under your protection, O destroyers of enemies.

sanskrit: gṛhamedhāsa ā gata maruto māpa bhūtana | yuṣmākotī sudānavaḥ ||
english: O Maruts, masters of the household, come; do not be absent. Under your protection, O liberal givers.

sanskrit: iheha vaḥ svatavasaḥ kavayaḥ sūryatvacaḥ | yajñam maruta ā vṛṇe ||
english: Here and here I invoke you, O Maruts — self-strong seers, bright as the skin of the sun — to the sacrifice.

sanskrit: tryambakaṁ yajāmahe sugandhim puṣṭivardhanam | urvārukam iva bandhanān mṛtyor mukṣīya māmṛtāt ||
english: We worship the three-eyed one, fragrant, increaser of flourishing. As a cucumber is freed from its stalk, may I be released from death — not from immortality.

sanskrit: yad adya sūrya bravo 'nāgā udyan mitrāya varuṇāya satyam | vayaṁ devatrādite syāma tava priyāso aryaman gṛṇantaḥ ||
english: What sinless truth you speak today, O Sūrya, rising to Mitra and Varuṇa — may we be dear to Aditi among the gods, praising you, O Aryaman.

sanskrit: eṣa sya mitrāvaruṇā nṛcakṣā ubhe ud eti sūryo abhi jman | viśvasya sthātur jagataś ca gopā ṛju marteṣu vṛjinā ca paśyan ||
english: This Sūrya, the man-beholding, rises up for both of you, O Mitra-Varuṇa, over the earth. Guardian of all things moving and still, beholding among mortals the straight and the crooked.

sanskrit: ayukta sapta haritaḥ sadhasthād yā īṁ vahanti sūryaṁ ghṛtācīḥ | dhāmāni mitrāvaruṇā yuvākuḥ saṁ yo yūtheva janimāni caṣṭe ||
english: He yoked the seven bay mares from his station that carry Sūrya, the bright-rayed ones. Mitra-Varuṇa seized their dwellings — he who surveys births together as if a herd.

sanskrit: ud vām pṛkṣāso madhumanto asthur ā sūryo aruhac chukram arṇaḥ | yasmā ādityā adhvano radanti mitro aryamā varuṇaḥ sajoṣāḥ ||
english: The honey-sweet refreshments have risen for you both; Sūrya has climbed the bright ocean. For him the Ādityas clear the paths — Mitra, Aryaman, Varuṇa in accord.

sanskrit: ime cetāro anṛtasya bhūrer mitro aryamā varuṇo hi santi | ima ṛtasya vāvṛdhur duroṇe śagmāsaḥ putrā aditer adabdhāḥ ||
english: These are indeed the punishers of abundant falsehood — Mitra, Aryaman, and Varuṇa. These have grown strong in the house of Ṛta, benign sons of Aditi, inviolable.

sanskrit: ime mitro varuṇo dūḻabhāso 'cetasaṁ cic citayanti dakṣaiḥ | api kratuṁ sucetasaṁ vatantas tiraś cid aṁhaḥ supathā nayanti ||
english: These Mitra and Varuṇa, hard to deceive, rouse even the unthinking with their powers. Guiding one toward right wisdom, even through straits they lead by good paths.

sanskrit: ime divo animiṣā pṛthivyāś cikitvāṁso acetasaṁ nayanti | pravrāje cin nadyo gādham asti pāraṁ no asya viṣpitasya parṣan ||
english: These, sleepless watchers of heaven and earth, guide even the thoughtless one. Even in the desert there is a ford in the river; may they carry us across the expanse of this flood.

sanskrit: yad gopāvad aditiḥ śarma bhadram mitro yacchanti varuṇaḥ sudāse | tasminn ā tokaṁ tanayaṁ dadhānā mā karma devaheḻanaṁ turāsaḥ ||
english: In that auspicious shelter which Aditi guards, which Mitra and Varuṇa grant to the liberal sacrificer — therein placing offspring and progeny, may we swift ones not commit offense against the gods.

sanskrit: ava vediṁ hotrābhir yajeta ripaḥ kāś cid varuṇadhrutaḥ saḥ ||pari dveṣobhir aryamā vṛṇaktūruṁ sudāse vṛṣaṇā u lokam ||
english: He who has been swayed by Varuṇa — let him worship away from the altar with priestly calls whatever sins he bears. May Aryaman cut the foe away; O bulls, free the world for the liberal one.

sanskrit: sasvaś cid dhi samṛtis tveṣy eṣām apīcyena sahasā sahante | yuṣmad bhiyā vṛṣaṇo rejamānā dakṣasya cin mahinā mṛḻatā naḥ ||
english: Their encounter is always fearsome; with secret power they overcome. The bulls tremble in fear of you; by the might of wisdom do you show grace to us.

sanskrit: yo brahmaṇe sumatim āyajāte vājasya sātau paramasya rāyaḥ | sīkṣanta manyum maghavāno arya uru kṣayāya cakrire sudhātu ||
english: He who has worshipped to win goodwill for the brahman — to win food, the highest wealth — may the bountiful lords suppress the wrath of the noble one and make a wide and well-founded abode.

sanskrit: iyaṁ deva purohitir yuvabhyāṁ yajñeṣu mitrāvaruṇāv akāri | viśvāni durgā pipṛtaṁ tiro no yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: O Mitra-Varuṇa, divine ones, this priestly office has been performed for you both in the sacrifices. Carry us through all difficulties; do ye protect us always with blessings.
